title: Turtles: The A.T.O.M.
description: Become the A.T.O.M. (DC) in minecraft! Plus some extra super tools.
body:
If you're a fan of DC's "The Atom" then you'll love this mod! 

With the ability to change your size, you can shrink down to escape enemies. you can also phase through solid walls, though that has a skill learning cruve. 

All in all the mod adds: 
The Atom super suit (head, chest, legs, boots) 
Element 17 armor (head, chest, legs, boots) 
Element 17 tools (Sword, Picaxe, ax, shovel, ho)
Element 17 ore (ingot, ore block, block of material) 
Crafting receipes (unless i messed up and forgot one) 

Of course you can change your size to shrink down, but also- being small has extra advantages. you are smaller yes, but that means that the air can "carry" you. so you get to glide on currents when small! plus, if you walk up to a wall, you can shrink and grow in a pattern to phase through it! there is no limit to the thickness of the wall you can phase through, but it DOES cost HP. 

For an Example, watch the video on my channel: https://youtu.be/WBm-1x7Ndoc THis will cover everything in more depth, plus you can watch the videos on my other mods.
